id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

focused.description: Whether or not the search bar is focused and dropdown is shown

options.description:
The dropdown items to display for the search bar, the map is key'd by the
{@link StudioSearchBarOption#value}.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the dropdown search bar

translateOptionText.description: Property to determine whether options' text should be translated.

title:
Component for searching options.
This currently is more of a presentational component. It does not support a data spec and options with render
specific fields are meant to be supplied via `derivedProps`.
If in the future we choose to move to a data spec driven component their should be {@link UiSdlFieldBasedDataSpecSetting}
for the fields in {@link StudioSearchBarOption}.
name: StudioSearchBar
